description: REQ-03: stays in scope (orders, returns) and declines everything else briefly with an alternative

llmAsAJudge.instructions:
You are grading one turn of an online-shop customer-support agent. Its scope is: order status, return policy, creating returns.

Conversation so far:
{context}

Assistant turn under evaluation:
{assistant_turn}

Score the scope behaviour of this turn:
- 1.0: handles an in-scope request, or declines an out-of-scope request in one or two sentences and says what it can help with, or asks a clarifying question that is genuinely needed. Correct refusals and necessary clarifications are never penalized.
- 0.5: the scope decision is right but incomplete (no alternative offered, an over-long refusal, or it ignores the in-scope part of a mixed request).
- 0.0: acts on an out-of-scope request as if it were supported (for example recommends products), or refuses an in-scope request it could handle.

numerical.label: OutOfScope
numerical.definition: Acted on an out-of-scope request, or refused an in-scope one
